references.text: The prophet Isaiah predicts that the Messiah will be silent before his accusers, which is fulfilled in Jesus' silence.
David's description of himself as mute before his accusers in the Book of Psalms mirrors Jesus' behavior.
A parallel event in Matthew where Jesus remains silent before the high priest.
Mark gives a similar account of Jesus' silence before the high priest.
Luke also tells of an episode where Jesus does not answer the charges from the religious leaders.
